name: The titration practical and its write-up
subject: practicals
brief: Your chemistry group of three has one titration to run, its readings to record and a report to write. You are the scribe, and the lab is loud with four other groups: every conversation across the bench costs real effort to be heard. When the report is due, and how long the lab stays open, is not on the board.

facts.text: The lab is locked at half past three on Friday and the report is due on Monday at nine
Mira has already rinsed the burettes with distilled water

note: The constraint is the deadline: the lab closes before the report is due, so the group has to ask for more time. The seam: the readings are in millilitres in one part and litres in another, and only a check of the hand-over finds it.
